verification.verdict: pass 2: all six declared repairs landed; one new HIGH defect (N1) found
notes: PASS 2 (repair round 1). Re-read the rewritten TenableIoAssetSpoolPhase.cs (314 -> 495 lines); pass-1 line citations for that file are superseded.

D1 CLOSED: dedicated AdapterHttpRequestFailedException/IsTransientOrRateLimited retry branch at TenableIoAssetSpoolPhase.cs:283-291 passes ex into ComputeDelay, so Retry-After is honoured and the ex parameter is no longer dead. Tests drive a real 429 with Retry-After and real 502/503/504 and assert a second HTTP call plus zero lost assets.

D2 CLOSED as specified: EnforceSkippedChunkCeiling at :92 runs before WriteManifestAsync at :96, RunAsync has no catch, and the test asserts no manifest object and TryReadManifestAsync null. MaxSkippedChunkRatio=0.5 with >= matches both live flows verbatim. The pure ExceedsSkippedChunkRatio is asserted over 4 rows including the exact 50% boundary.

NEW DEFECT N1 (HIGH): the ceiling counts chunks that FAILED, never chunks that were never OFFERED. Nothing reconciles Processed+Excluded against TotalChunks, and FindNewChunkIds only attempts chunks in chunks_available. A FINISHED export declaring 4 chunks while listing 1 yields a quarter-full spine with a completion manifest, no warning, no failure - the same hazard D2 closed, by the other road. Demonstrated by a PASSING test: SpoolPhase_WhenAChunkIsFailedServerSide stubs total_chunks:4/available:[1]/failed:[4], leaving chunks 2 and 3 unvisited (proved by contradiction: a 404 on them would join Excluded and trip the ceiling). Makes the class doc claim 'incompleteness is bounded, not silent' false as written.
CR#3 CONFIRMED: cap is exactly 2 re-creations (:197 with MaxExportRecreations=2), a delay precedes each (:212), third 404 throws, no manifest. Test asserts creates==3 and no manifest.

D3 CLOSED: TryGetStagedAssetId locates the spine prefix inside the canonical URL (:205-210), the dead Relative() helper is gone, and unrecognized objects are counted and warned once with first-offender detail. The LocationFactory test re-spells the base with the same canonical URL and both ids come back.

D4 CLOSED AT UNIT LEVEL ONLY: RequireObjectStore/RequireBaseStorageUrl exist and throw, both tested (the latter over a real AdapterProgressContext). Still invoked by no production path, so the honest claim is 'the guard throws', not 'the flow hard-fails'.

CR#7/#8 all verified: OCE filter discriminates caller cancellation (internal OCE correctly falls through to terminal skip since the classifier returns false for OperationCanceledException); poll counting moved out of the filter; circuit-breaker failures now count toward the ceiling; test double locks all members incl. snapshot getters; GuardedObjectStore disposed via IDisposable on the test class; RunAsync decomposed with SpoolPass + TenableIoAssetSpoolRequest. All three restated doc claims (stat+read on a 4-slot semaphore with the 1-8 MiB memory-pressure caveat, the reusable-buffer rationale, the 'one path' scoping) are now accurate against Infra source.
SC8 mostly met: Documentation/01 +42 lines and collector-flow-patterns/SKILL.md +17 lines, both accurate. ai/skills/collector-recovery is still untouched - SC8 names it.
A1a now PARTIALLY closed: documentation half done (and better than asked - it states what the vendor does NOT promise); the straddle test half is still open and belongs to phase 2.

A16 REJECTED: LocalAdapterRunner DID need a structural change - new LocalFileAdapterObjectStore.cs (194 lines) plus a 16-line fallback registration, because S3ObjectStoreWiring is compiled out behind HAS_ISB_AWS.

UNDECLARED DELTA: the LocalAdapterRunner change was not in the lead's delta list and is the only tracked-file change this round. Well-built and correctly caveated, but (a) it changes local-run semantics for EVERY staged collector - Falcon previously hard-failed locally with no store and will now silently succeed against the filesystem; (b) PathFor hashes location.BaseUrl, so identical canonical URLs with different base/relative splits map to different files - the very property D3 was fixed to respect.

Test change SpoolPhase_WhenAChunkIsFailedServerSide 1-of-2 -> 1-of-4 was SHARPENED, not bent: the >=-at-0.5 boundary is inherited verbatim from both live flows and required by constraints.md, and the boundary is still covered directly by the pure theory row (4,0,2,true). But the new stub is what encodes N1 as acceptable, so it must change again once N1 is fixed.

Run-failure judgement call: AGREE with the lead, and it is not a judgement call - constraints.md requires keeping the MaxSkippedChunkRatio guard, both live flows already fail on this exact ratio, and the operator's 'no failures/no fallbacks' statement is scoped in decisions.md to designs carrying a size cliff, not to refusing bad input. The same decision explicitly accepts a hard stop at flow entry for a missing IAdapterObjectStore.

Tests re-run by me: TenableIoAssetSpineTests 43/43 passed (13 s, count independently derived from source); full suite 57 passed / 1 failed / 58 total, the failure being the pre-existing dev defect at TenableIoCollectorTests.cs:696. Solution build still 0 warnings / 81 errors, all in YamlAdapter.Test, byte-identical to baseRef - red on dev, not this work.
